title: Reading: La Fontaine, Fables (selections)
subtitle: Le Corbeau et le Renard, La Cigale et la Fourmi. Short, simple verse fables.
objectives: Apply the concepts in reading and writing.

sections.heading: Main content
sections.body: La Fontaine's Fables are written in clear, elegant verse. The vocabulary is simple, the syntax is straightforward, and the moral is explicit. They are the perfect first sustained reading in French.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can apply the concepts without hesitation.
